realms.name: Aeralis · The Shattered Sky
realms.story: The space expedition reveals that Frostmere’s watchstones are losing their light. Travel to Aeralis to recover the Dawn Prism, guarded by the fractured celestial regent. Its return stabilizes the home-world network.

realms.name: The Crucible · Iron Below
realms.story: Much later, a siege and a broken ward expose the engine feeding the invasion. Descend into an industrial hell, defeat the Furnace Maw and recover its heart. Infernal guns and alloys can return home; ammunition remains a resource.

spells.name: Starfall
spells.description: Three converging crystal bolts; each deals 34% of spell power.

spells.name: Soulfire Lance
spells.description: A powerful infernal bolt. High damage, high magicka cost.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.description: Conductor primary attack. Two jumps within five meters, each retaining 65% of previous damage.

spells.name: Sunlance
spells.description: An aimed ray of sunlight that passes through one enemy to strike a second for 70% of its initial damage. Solid walls stop it.
